summary: The sealed actual numeric candidate has one reproduced defect in smoothing-matched sensitivity summaries. Core conditional covariance, mean comparison and numerical checks passed within their declared scope. Repair the summaries from retained matrices before scoped acceptance.

findings.title: Match smoothing radius in footprint/method sensitivity references
findings.mechanism: baseline is truncated once to total[:36,:36] (R=5), then reused for R=10 and R=20. Both trace_ratio_to_full_sample and frobenius_relative_to_full_sample mix footprint/method changes with smoothing changes.
findings.affected_claim: Footprint/method covariance sensitivity at fixed declared R=10 or R=20 h^-1 Mpc; eight rows and sixteen summary values are affected.
findings.consequence: For excluding FP at R=20, the summary appears to reduce the covariance trace by 3.54 percent, while the actual matched-radius operator increases it by 17.10 percent. This reverses the direction of that sensitivity conclusion.
findings.unaffected: Stored 108x108 subset covariances, PV factors, main covariance, all R=5 summaries, conditional mean model calculation, TABLE.csv, FIGURE.png and current interpretation R=5 numbers.
findings.repair_plan: Use the matched-radius full covariance block as the reference in run_sensitivity.py (full_total[36*ir:36*(ir+1), 36*ir:36*(ir+1)]). Regenerate only SENSITIVITY.json summary fields from the existing SENSITIVITY_MATRICES.npz and STAGE_C.npz; do not rerun source transforms, change quadrature/model/tolerances, or alter retained numerical matrices. Add a focused regression with distinct covariance blocks at each radius, including an identity subset that must return ratio 1 and relative Frobenius 0 at every radius, and check all twelve actual subset/radius summaries against their matched-radius references. Preserve the failed candidate/first falsifier receipts; reseal changed source/summary artifacts and return the new candidate for one targeted independent closeout under the same R36-02 task and cumulative account.

successful_checks: Exact manifest SHA and 28 product/external/frozen-contract source bindings verified; original candidate still unchanged at closeout.
Exact 36x35970 operator and aligned source identities agree with upstream reviewed candidate.
Frozen bridge suite: 8 tests and 10 subtests passed unchanged.
Independent ten-source oscillatory pair kernel with coincident rows, Gaussian smoothing and full normalization passed; phase-omission and normalization mutants fail.
Independent hypergeometric growing-mode solution and adaptive comoving-distance integration agree with retained finite background.
Ten selected retained full-catalogue complex modes agree with independent direct source sums; 108-coordinate factor Gram matrices reproduce retained covariance.
Full 108-coordinate angular/radial refinement passes support-whitened spectral bound even at 1e-12 cutoff; covariance support itself remains tolerance dependent.

Independent conditional covariance reconstruction uses D=150^2 and four method-design offsets with SD0.4 in km/s/Mpc, preserving PV cross-window/radius terms and excluding inherited baseline variance.

QR reproduction matches all three mean fits and stable unit-column ranks at 1e-12,1e-10,1e-8. All mean spaces contain the shared monopole, so null-mean estimation leaves selection/residual distribution invariant.
Independent Gaussian selection calibration reproduces counts 1886/113/1, zero exceedances and plus-one tail 1/2001. All nine D/Sigma sensitivity laws agree within 2.08e-12 absolute numerical error.
Actual source-observer response has relative-only rank3 at all three thresholds and common-velocity null below3e-17.
Full-mask subset refit reproduces exact upstream A with zero relative difference. Figure/table and R=5 prose agree with retained covariance.

physics_math_audit.assumptions: Fixed selected CF4 positions/weights, analytic EH98 no-wiggle Gaussian common field, finite physical k bands, three Gaussian smoothing radii, retained matter+Lambda growth. Numerical total explicitly stipulates independent source noise/calibration/PV components; empirical cross-source law remains unknown.
physics_math_audit.conventions: (-,+,+,+); outward ICRS J2000; released z_CMB proxies; c=299792.458 km/s; k in Mpc^-1, chi and R in Mpc, P0 in Mpc^3; g in km/s/Mpc; V in km/s; A in Mpc^-1; covariance in (km/s/Mpc)^2.
physics_math_audit.equations: Pair kernel J=((j0+j2)/3)(ni.nj)-j2(ni.shat)(nj.shat); coincident limit(ni.nj)/3. Positive angular pair weights and dk P/(2pi^2) give a PSD common-field covariance. K=A[d onehot(method)] maps mean-design shifts in km/s/Mpc, not magnitude zero-points.
physics_math_audit.limits: Common source/observer velocity cancels. No phase omitted; no magnitude derivative introduced; no inherited250 km/s component double-added. No native Boltzmann solver or ODE execution.
physics_math_audit.claim_tier_recommendation: CONDITIONAL_MODEL_COVARIANCE may be considered after F01 repair and formal candidate binding; not empirical source coverage or original campaign admission.

statistical_limits.tail_interpretation: Finite conditional Gaussian-reference diagnostic. Reported MC SE is an approximate plug-in summary using the plus-one estimate. The zero count does not resolve a tail below the Monte Carlo resolution.
statistical_limits.sample_covariance: Hypothetical N64,p36 Wishart uncertainty is reported beyond Hartlap factor: diagonal fractional SD sqrt(2/63) and off-diagonal entry variance. Actual inference uses stipulated analytic covariance, not a noisy sample covariance.
